desc: Great food. A short walk away.
demo: Demo · All places, prices and reviews are fictional.
emptyText: Try a higher budget or a wider radius, up to 1 km.
unknown: Not enough verified local prices yet.
priceNote: Price range for the selected meal. Extras may cost more.
noSavedText: Save a place from its detail page.
privacy: Location is requested automatically when the app opens, subject to system permission. No background tracking. Budget and saved places stay on this device. Opening navigation shares the destination with your chosen map service.
rank: Ranked by rating weighted by review count. Search results stay fixed until you search again.
imprecise: Your location is too approximate for this walking radius. Enable precise location and try again.
coverage: Verified meal prices are not available in this city yet.
noMenus: No verified menus nearby for this meal yet.
limited: Too many searches. Please wait a minute.
broad: Many places nearby. Try a smaller distance for a more precise search.
partial: Results include places with verified menu prices. Coverage is still growing.
permission: Location unavailable. Check your device permissions or explore the demo.
noProvider: Live restaurant data is not connected yet. Your location has not been sent to a restaurant provider. You can explore the clearly labelled demo.
error: Could not load verified restaurant data. Try again later.
route: Walking time is shown by your navigation app.
